_readme: Maps asset keys (see Collection / Asset Atlas in-game) to files inside /assets. Listed files replace the procedural art. A value can be a path (PNG sprite sheet, animated PNG, or WEBP at any whole-number scale) or an object: { "file", "frames": n | [per row] | ["frame files"], "rows": [one strip/APNG/frame list per row], "scale", "anchor": [x, y] }. Images bigger than maxScale x the game size are downsampled once at load. See ASSET_SPEC.md.
